Added.Description: It accepts the name of the Tally Server.

It accepts any one of the keywords- HASINFO, ISEDUCATIONAL, and LICENSEEXPIRYDAYSLEFT. HASINFO returns true or false if the client is able to get information for this TallyPrime Server (otherwise ISEDUCATIONAL and LICENSEEXPIRYDAYSLEFT fail in a TDL expression). ISEDUCATIONAL returns true if the TallyPrime Server is running in educational mode and LICENSEEXPIRYDAYSLEFT will return the number of subscription days remaining.
